name: vip90-bet
description: Self-hosted betting and casino platform: sportsbook, casino, wallet, bonuses, KYC, risk and admin panel.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "node scripts/optional-run.mjs odds-provider npm run dev --prefix odds-provider"
scripts.dev:games: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "node scripts/optional-run.mjs odds-provider npm run dev --prefix odds-provider" "node scripts/optional-run.mjs game-host npm run dev --prefix game-host"
scripts.install:all: npm i && npm i --prefix server && npm i --prefix client && node scripts/optional-run.mjs game-host npm i --prefix game-host && node scripts/optional-run.mjs odds-provider npm i --prefix odds-provider
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:game-host: node scripts/optional-run.mjs game-host sh -c "npm install --prefix game-host && npm run build --prefix game-host"
scripts.test: node --test server/test/*.test.js client/src/i18n/*.test.js client/src/pages/admin/dashboard/*.test.js client/src/pages/admin/*.test.js client/src/utils/*.test.js shared/*.test.js client/scripts/__tests__/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.docker:test: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml build test && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test
